VP-Head of High-Value Mobility Growth

The Head of High-Value Mobility Growth is responsible for growing and retaining high-value customer segments, including postpaid, SME and roaming users. This role focuses on driving customer loyalty, increasing revenue through upsell and cross-sell strategies, and enhancing customer experience to maximize lifetime value.

By leveraging data-driven insights, customer segmentation, and targeted engagement programs, the Head of High-Value Mobility Growth ensures that high-value customers receive personalized offerings and superior service. Working closely with sales, product, and customer experience teams, this role plays a key part in reducing churn, improving retention, and driving sustainable revenue growth in Indonesia’s competitive telecom market.

Responsibilities

• Develop and implement strategies to grow the postpaid and SME customer base.
• Develop and implement strategies to grow the roaming customer base.
• Design and execute loyalty programs to enhance customer retention.
• Drive revenue growth by optimizing cross-sell and upsell initiatives.
• Use customer analytics to personalize offerings and improve engagement.
• Monitor revenue performance and align marketing efforts with business targets.
• Ensure seamless and enhanced customer journeys to drive satisfaction.
• Collaborate with Product, Sales, and Customer Experience teams for seamless execution.
• Build and mentor a high-performing marketing team with a focus on innovation and agility.

Qualifications

• Experience in postpaid, SME & Roaming customer segment growth.
• Strong background in loyalty and customer retention marketing.
• Ability to leverage data for customer segmentation and personalization.
• Proven track record in cross-sell and upsell optimization.
• Expertise in driving high-value customer engagement strategies.
• Strong leadership and analytical skills.

Job Summary

Lead the planning, monitoring, and control of OPEX and CAPEX budgets for mining operations to ensure effective cost management and alignment with production plans and business objectives. Oversee cost forecasting, expenditure analysis, and cost estimation for tenders and bids, providing reliable financial insights to support decision-making. Drive cost optimization, budget compliance, and financial discipline to enhance operational efficiency and achieve production targets at optimal cost.

Job Responsibilities

• Lead the development of annual OPEX and CAPEX budgets for mining operations by consolidating cross-functional inputs and aligning budget assumptions with production plans, operational requirements, and business objectives.
• Oversee budget utilization and expenditure control against approved budgets and forecasts, including the review of actual costs, commitments, and variances, and coordinate corrective actions with relevant stakeholders.
• Direct the preparation of periodic forecasts, cost projections, and scenario analyses by evaluating production volumes, fuel prices, equipment performance, and other key cost drivers to support financial planning and decision-making.
• Oversee cost estimation, financial modelling, and pricing validation for mining tenders and bids to ensure cost assumptions are reliable and proposed pricing aligns with business objectives, target margins, and identified commercial risks.
• Lead cost optimization initiatives and strengthen financial discipline through expenditure reviews, internal controls, compliance with company policies, and monitoring of savings initiatives across mining operations.
• Lead, develop, and coordinate the cost control and budgeting team to ensure effective resource allocation, analytical capability, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in cost management processes.

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Mining Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Accounting, Finance or Economics

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Minimum 10 years of experience in mining, heavy equipment or related industries.
• Deepunderstanding of mining operational cost structure
• Advance knowledge and skill in ERP systems (SAP preferred), advanced Excel and Power BI.
• Strong analytical, problem solving and business acumen.
• Fluent in English, spoken and written.

Certification
